name: Mini Fuzz: Ocean World
summary:
Help King Starf by locating the Starf Kids, and defending the castle from Mini-Subs, loose Sea Horses, and Goldfish! Mini Fuzz: Ocean World is a fast-paced, challenging arcade shooter for all ages.

Gumbo the Dumbo Octopus is the only one that can help King Starf. Using the powerful bubble burst, Gumbo will need wits, speed, and accuracy to defend the kingdom and win all 15 King's Medals.

Mini Fuzz: Ocean World is a cozy underwater arcade shooter with 15 challenging levels that have Gumbo collecting Starf
